mapper.sql: id, delivery_id, order_sub_id, order_sub_item_id, product_id, specification_id, location_id, number, shipped_number, category_specification_item_id, category_specification_item_name, create_user, create_time, update_user, update_time, tenant_id, is_deleted
mapper.select:
SELECT sydi.*, (select code from pro_yt_product where id = sydi.product_id) as productCode, (select order_id from sal_yt_order_sub where is_deleted=0 and id = sydi.order_sub_id) as orderId
FROM sto_yt_delivery_item as sydi WHERE sydi.delivery_id = #{deliveryId} AND sydi.is_deleted = 0
SELECT sydi.* FROM sto_yt_delivery_item as sydi WHERE order_sub_item_id = #{orderSubItemId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT order_sub_id, (select sub_code from sal_yt_order_sub where id = order_sub_id) as orderSubCode FROM sto_yt_delivery_item as sydi WHERE delivery_id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 group by order_sub_id
select sum(number) as number, order_sub_item_id from sto_yt_delivery_item as sydi WHERE delivery_id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 group by order_sub_item_id
select sum(number) as number from sto_yt_delivery_item as sydi WHERE order_sub_item_id = #{id} and delivery_id in(select id from sto_yt_delivery where status=1) AND is_deleted = 0
select sum(number) as number from sto_yt_delivery_item as sydi WHERE order_sub_item_id = #{id} and delivery_id in(select id from sto_yt_delivery where status>0) AND is_deleted = 0

select order_sub_id as orderSubId, sum(number) as quantity,(select sub_code from sal_yt_order_sub where id = sydi.order_sub_id) as subCode from sto_yt_delivery_item as sydi WHERE delivery_id = #{deliveryId} AND is_deleted = 0 group by order_sub_id

select syo.id as orderId, sum(sydi.number) as quantity, -- (select sub_code from sal_yt_order_sub where id = sydi.order_sub_id) as subCode MAX(syos.sub_code) as subCode, MAX(syo.code) as orderCode from sto_yt_delivery_item as sydi left join sal_yt_order_sub as syos on syos.id = sydi.order_sub_id left join sal_yt_order as syo on syo.id = syos.order_id WHERE delivery_id = #{deliveryId} AND sydi.is_deleted = 0 AND syos.is_deleted = 0 AND syo.is_deleted = 0 AND syo.is_collected_shipping_cost = 0 group by syo.id, syos.sub_code

select order_sub_id, sum(number) as quantity,(select sub_code from sal_yt_order_sub where id = sydi.order_sub_id) as subCode from sto_yt_delivery_item as sydi JOIN sal_yt_order_sub sos ON sydi.order_sub_id = sos.id join sal_yt_order so ON sos.order_id = so.id WHERE delivery_id = #{deliveryId} AND sydi.is_deleted = 0 AND so.is_collected_shipping_cost = 0 AND so.is_deleted = 0 group by order_sub_id

SELECT sd.id, sd.code, sd.delivery_time, sd.status, sd.delivery_amount, sdi.order_sub_id, SUM(sdi.number) as subOrderQuantity, (SELECT SUM(number) FROM sto_yt_delivery_item WHERE delivery_id = sd.id AND is_deleted = 0) as totalDeliveryQuantity, (SUM(sdi.number) / (SELECT SUM(number) FROM sto_yt_delivery_item WHERE delivery_id = sd.id AND is_deleted = 0)) as deliveryProportion, (select name from sto_yt_transport_company where id = sd.transport_company_id) as transportCompanyName, (select url from sys_storage where id=sd.transport_order_file_id) as transportOrderFileUrl FROM sto_yt_delivery_item sdi LEFT JOIN sto_yt_delivery sd ON sdi.delivery_id = sd.id WHERE sdi.order_sub_id = #{subId} AND sdi.is_deleted = 0 AND sd.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY sdi.delivery_id

SELECT syo.id as orderId, syo.code as orderCode FROM sto_yt_delivery_item as sydi left join sal_yt_order_sub as syos on syos.id = sydi.order_sub_id left join sal_yt_order as syo on syo.id = syos.order_id WHERE delivery_id = #{id} AND sydi.is_deleted = 0 group by syo.id

SELECT syo.id as orderId, syo.code as orderCode, syo.shipping_method as shippingMethod, syo.remark as orderRemark, syo.delivery_time as orderDeliveryTime, (select nick_name from sys_user where user_id = syo.sale_employee_id) as saleEmployeeName, -- 打包数量状态：如果入库数量-发货数量大于打包数量则为false，否则为true (CASE WHEN (SELECT SUM(syosi.enter_number - syosi.delivery_number) FROM sal_yt_order_sub syos2 JOIN sal_yt_order_sub_item syosi ON syosi.order_sub_id = syos2.id WHERE syos2.order_id = syo.id AND syosi.specification_id IS NOT NULL AND syosi.is_deleted = 0) > (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sydbi.number), 0) FROM sto_yt_delivery_box_item sydbi JOIN sto_yt_delivery_box sydb ON sydb.id = sydbi.delivery_box_id JOIN sto_yt_delivery syd ON syd.id = sydb.delivery_id JOIN sto_yt_delivery_item sdi ON sdi.delivery_id = syd.id JOIN sal_yt_order_sub syos3 ON syos3.id = sdi.order_sub_id WHERE syd.id = #{deliveryId} AND syos3.order_id = syo.id AND sydbi.is_deleted = 0 AND sdi.is_deleted = 0) THEN false ELSE true END) as packageComplete FROM sto_yt_delivery_item as sydi left join sal_yt_order_sub as syos on syos.id = sydi.order_sub_id left join sal_yt_order as syo on syo.id = syos.order_id where sydi.is_deleted=0 and sydi.delivery_id = #{deliveryId} group by syo.id
select * from sto_yt_delivery_item where order_sub_item_id = #{orderSubItemId}

SELECT sd.id, sd.code, sd.delivery_time, sd.status, sd.delivery_amount, sdi.order_sub_id, SUM(sdi.number) as subOrderQuantity, (SELECT SUM(number) FROM sto_yt_delivery_item WHERE delivery_id = sd.id AND is_deleted = 0) as totalDeliveryQuantity, (SUM(sdi.number) / (SELECT SUM(number) FROM sto_yt_delivery_item WHERE delivery_id = sd.id AND is_deleted = 0)) as deliveryProportion, (select name from sto_yt_transport_company where id = sd.transport_company_id) as transportCompanyName, (select url from sys_storage where id=sd.transport_order_file_id) as transportOrderFileUrl FROM sto_yt_delivery_item sdi LEFT JOIN sto_yt_delivery sd ON sdi.delivery_id = sd.id WHERE sdi.order_sub_id = #{subId} AND sdi.is_deleted = 0 AND sd.is_deleted = 0 and sd.status > 0 GROUP BY sdi.delivery_id
SELECT SUM(number) FROM sto_yt_delivery_item WHERE delivery_id = #{deliveryId} AND is_deleted = 0

select sum(a.number) from sto_yt_delivery_item a left join sal_yt_order_sub b on a.order_sub_id=b.id left join sal_yt_order c on b.order_id=c.id where a.is_deleted=0 and b.is_deleted=0 and a.delivery_id=#{deliveryId} and c.is_collected_shipping_cost =0
